notes: The review focuses on experimental transport lookalikes and does not critique the RSJ theoretical model (missing C5, C12, C18). It strongly captures C14 via specific NbSe2 vortex-matter analogues (ramp-rate-dependent pinning, edge-injected disorder, and peak-effect metastability). C3, C4, and C19 are graded 'partly': the review questions why the cleanest sample S3 was omitted from dc pulse tests and how the memory window shifts with sample quality (neighbouring C3's concern about RRR dependence), proposes a single-phase peak-effect explanation for the non-monotonic Jc(B) region (neighbouring C4), and asks for local heating/thermometer details while citing electron-heating literature (neighbouring C19's quasiparticle accumulation/local heating concern).
